review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26107702, totalAssets=65181542.209163 FRAX, totalSupply=56157359.111527 sFRAX, convertToAssets(1e18)=1.160694577530153970 FRAX and FRAX balance=65471813.491358. Balance exceeds accounted assets by 290271.282195 FRAX; the pinned LinearRewards implementation classifies undistributed balance as rewards rather than external deployed assets. Exact-deployment source and current Safe state establish the local share and parameter paths; parent native mint authority is inherited separately. Exact implementation creation transaction 0xecd4ab27bc3b4c300b11405fc6a156ee316ad3f4c24f63130cbcbc49ae6bef55, block 18378085, timestamp 2023-10-18T15:19:11+00:00, was independently joined from Blockscout creation identity to RPC transaction receipt and block timestamp; issuer founding and parent launch were not substituted. Separate signer/key-custody observation, recorded per identified control rather than as an aggregate issuance-census gap: Offchain key custody and independence of the six Safe signer addresses remain unestablished; onchain quorum/source census cannot identify independent human or institutional key holders. Calibration v2 field re-justification: reconciliation=not-applicable describes the immutable deposit-backed local share mechanism and does not assert parent reserve-to-total-liability financial assurance; supervision=none grants no prudential-supervision credit. Source-defined share accounting and independent financial assurance retain separate scopes.
